title: Censored LLMs as a Natural Testbed for Secret Knowledge Elicitation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the extent to which Chinese-developed LLMs censor or provide false information on politically sensitive topics (e.g., Tiananmen Square, Falun Gong, Uyghurs) by comparing model responses to ground-truth facts extracted from an uncensored reference model (GPT-4.1) and calculating honesty scores, refusal rates, and fact contradiction rates.
